# Manus

AI-powered task automation and workflow management platform

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/manus/.

## Actions

- **Create New Project**: Create a new project with default instructions.
- **Create New Task**: Creates a new AI task with custom parameters, attachments, and optional connectors.
- **Get Task** (read-only): Retrieves details of a specific task by ID, including status, output messages, credit usage, and metadata.
- **Get Webhook Public Key** (read-only): Retrieves the RSA public key used for verifying webhook signatures.
- **List tasks** (read-only): Retrieves a list of tasks with optional filtering and pagination.
- **Create File**: Create a file record and obtain a presigned URL for uploading file content to S3.
- **Create Webhook**: Register a webhook to receive real-time task notifications.
- **Delete a file**: Deletes a file by ID.
- **Delete task**: Permanently delete a task by its ID.
- **Delete Webhook**: Removes a webhook subscription.
- **Get file details** (read-only): Retrieves details of a specific file by ID, including its status and metadata.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all projects in your account with optional pagination.
- **List uploaded files** (read-only): Retrieves a list of the 10 most recently uploaded files.
- **Update Task**: Updates a task's metadata such as title, sharing settings, and visibility in the task list.
